phase_8_scope.representative_failure: boundary iMF live interval error increased after 5000 optimizer steps while the paired auxiliary construction reduced it
phase_8_scope.failure_category_under_test: algorithmic: optimization instability caused by the boundary-derived marginal-velocity target
phase_8_scope.hypothesis: an independently predicted marginal-velocity target prevents live interval-error drift across training seeds
phase_8_scope.exact_change: replace only the boundary-derived marginal-velocity target with the source-derived auxiliary head; keep data, backbone width, optimizer, schedule, batches, and validation fixed within each seed
phase_8_scope.expected_if_true: auxiliary iMF has lower final live interval_raw_l2 than boundary iMF for every seed, improves by at least 5 percent on average, and its auxiliary interval error decreases
phase_8_scope.expected_if_false: the paired advantage is inconsistent across seeds, averages below 5 percent, or the auxiliary interval target fails to improve

task.goal_relabeling: deterministic future state from the same episode only

report: mean and sample standard deviation across training seeds
analysis.inferential_limit: three seeds are insufficient for strong distributional or significance claims; no episode-level values will be treated as training-seed replicates

acceptance.directional_consistency: auxiliary final live interval_raw_l2 lower than boundary for all three seeds
acceptance.mean_superiority: mean paired auxiliary reduction at least 5 percent
acceptance.auxiliary_feasibility: auxiliary final live interval_raw_l2 lower than initialization for all three seeds
acceptance.auxiliary_head_learning: auxiliary final live aux_interval_raw_l2 lower than initialization for all three seeds
